name: set-field
description: Set, or regex-replace, one field on many items: pages, datasources, or records under Data.
when: A bulk field change the content planner does not cover: fill an image everywhere it is empty, add +1 to phone numbers, hide pages from the sitemap, fix a value on department records.

inputs.paths: item paths to change (or use root)
inputs.root: walk this item and everything under it
inputs.template: only items of this template (name or id)
inputs.replace: { pattern, flags, with } instead of value: regex replace on the current value
inputs.onlyEmpty: true: only items where the field is empty
inputs.limit: stop after visiting this many items under root (default 5000)

provenance.from: reference project: hero background fill, phone +1 on pages and department records
